query: Can I cancel the payment after I have confirmed the payment utilising my GovCash on the LifeSG mobile app?
reference_answer: No, your GovCash balance will be deducted upon successful payment.
answer: Based on the information available, there's no direct way to cancel a payment once it's confirmed using GovCash through the LifeSG mobile app. You would need to contact their customer service for any cancellations. [Document N]
